company.name: Corvane Mutual
company.about: a fictional property insurer rolling out three AI assistants on one MemoryLake memory

projects.name: Underwriting policy
projects.description: Underwriting rules every assistant may need to read
facts: Claims paid out above 5,000 dollars need a senior adjuster's sign-off.
Flood cover in zone A requires an elevation certificate issued within the last 10 years.
Roof damage on homes older than 25 years is settled at actual cash value, not replacement cost.
A claim must be reported within 60 days of the loss to be accepted without review.
Water damage from a slow leak (over 14 days) is excluded unless the policy has the seepage rider.
Policyholders get one free re-inspection per claim; a second one is billed at 150 dollars.
